description: This PHP source file defines functions related to layer capabilities, JavaScript code generation for layer behavior, and HTML output for layers in the Revive Adserver project, specifically for handling cursor layer styles and positioning.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetLimitations
methods.description: Returns capabilities of the client's browser, such as compatibility and rich media support.

methods.name: MAX_layerPutJs
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to control layer positioning, visibility, and movement based on mouse position.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML code for rendering a layer with specified output parameters.
